function: Uplink pilot-based channel estimation for XL-MIMO with decentralized baseband processing: GNN-enhanced SBL as local estimator, then non-learned Bayesian refinement at the CPU (pp. 1-2, 5).
system: BS with 128-antenna ULA split into M=4 hybrid analog-digital subarrays (1 RF chain each), single-antenna users, OFDM, mmWave 30 GHz, 1.6 GHz bandwidth; no RIS (pp. 3, 11).
method: Deep-unfolded SBL: GNN (pairwise-MRF prior, MLP and GRU) replaces the M-step prior-variance update; supervised MSE training with Adam, 50 epochs, random SNR; refinement is non-learned (p. 9).
data_channel: Own simulated spherical-wavefront dual-wideband channel [17], G=4 paths, random AoA, 10-50 m distances; 10,000 test samples per SNR point (pp. 3, 9, 11).
test_conditions: Train: SNR uniform in a range; test: fresh samples per SNR point (0-10 dB), sweeps of pilots P=12-32 and subarrays M=2,4,8; same channel model (pp. 9, 11-13).
baselines: Non-learned: StdSBL, PC-SBL, VSP, UAMP-MRF and centralized UAMP-SBL (M=1), also with the proposed refinement; no learned baseline (pp. 11-13).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR and versus pilot symbols, NMSE gap before and after refinement, algorithm runtime of local and overall schemes (pp. 11-14).
complexity: Big-O per algorithm in Table II (p. 11); SBL-GNNs total counted in multiplications (p. 8); measured runtime on an i7-9700 CPU (pp. 11-12).
q1_support: p. 3: "we adopt a uniform spherical-wavefront-based channel model [17]". Custom simulator with the Table I parameters (p. 11: G=4 paths, AoA U(-pi/2, pi/2)); no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 9: "a dataset comprising 10,000 samples per SNR point was generated for evaluation". Tests are SNR sweeps plus pilot and subarray sweeps (pp. 12-13); the paper never states that a trained model was applied to a scenario, configuration or dataset not used in training.
q3_support: p. 11: "we compare our proposed SBL-GNNs algorithm with the following benchmarks, which adopt different sparse prior models". The benchmarks (StdSBL, PC-SBL, VSP, UAMP-MRF, centralized UAMP-SBL) are all non-learned; no earlier learned estimator or standard NN is compared, so the learned baseline is missing.
q4_support: p. 8: "we elaborate on the computational complexity in terms of the number of multiplications of the proposed SBL-GNNs algorithm". Table II (p. 11) lists the order of complexity; runtime on an i7-9700 CPU is compared in Fig. 6 (pp. 11-12).
q5_support: p. 9: "a dataset comprising 10,000 samples per SNR point was generated for evaluation". The data come from the authors' own simulator (p. 3); the paper gives no code or data link and names no public or measured dataset.
notes: Included: the first stage is a trained GNN-unfolded SBL (deep unfolding with trained parameters), so a learned component performs channel estimation (area 2); the second stage (variational message passing refinement, pp. 9-10) is not learned. The training SNR range is not given numerically (p. 9). Fig. 5 (subarray sweep) and Fig. 7(b) (pilot sweep) do not say whether the network was retrained or reused; p. 9 says only that the number of NN parameters is independent of the number of subarrays, so q2 is 0. The PDF is the arXiv v4 preprint (27 Apr 2025) and does not print the DOI.
